races.paceDynamic: Alazwar sits as the sole confirmed front-runner with Man Is King the only other prominent runner, setting up a potentially uncontested lead scenario. With nine hold-up horses behind this thin pace, Alazwar can dictate fractions without early pressure and kick clear when the field closes late. The lack of pace pressure means the leaders can conserve energy for a strong finish while the hold-up brigade faces a wall of traffic in the straight. This race shape strongly favours the front-running and prominent runners who can secure clear racing room.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Alazwar leads unchallenged through moderate early fractions
scenarios.body: Alazwar controls the tempo completely and has enough left to repel late challengers, while Man Is King benefits from the prominent position. The mass of hold-up horses struggle to make ground against horses who've conserved energy up front.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If both Alazwar and Man Is King go too steady early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where the classier hold-up horses can unleash their turn of foot. Pay Attention and Romanovich have the highest ratings to capitalize when the pace collapses completely.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Nightmare Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If the field bunches up turning for home with leaders still there
scenarios.body: Alazwar maintains his advantage while most hold-up horses get shuffled back in traffic problems. Only those with the best positions like King Of The Dance can thread through for minor placings.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Early Pace Duel
scenarios.trigger: If Man Is King or another runner challenges Alazwar early
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes too strong and both leaders weaken, allowing the best of the hold-up horses to sweep past. Romanovich's recent win and Pay Attention's class edge them forward.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Man Is King or any other runner goes with Alazwar early as it could set up completely different race dynamics
Watch the break from the stalls as nine hold-up horses could cause early interference and positioning issues
Watch Alazwar's early fractions as he could steal an unassailable advantage if allowed to coast
Watch Pay Attention for market support given the long absence but clear class edge
Watch for scrimmaging in the straight as the hold-up brigade will all be finishing at once

races.name: Blast Event Hire EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Moulin Booj

runners_data.name: Desert Cop

runners_data.name: Regal Envoy
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with decent recent Goodwood third who should get ideal position tracking the leaders.

runners_data.name: Angel Shared
runners_data.note: Front runner with better recent form than pace rival Ruby's Profit and proven ability on this ground.

runners_data.name: Fidelius
runners_data.note: Prominent runner improving rapidly on turf this season with excellent AW form translating well.
runners_data.comment: Better than ever on AW in recent times; 0-8 on turf and has a career-high mark to overcome
runners_data.spotlight: 6-17 on AW and better than ever this spring, following his Lingfield win in March with a narrow defeat at Southwell; 0-8 on turf but has run well on fast ground in the past; perhaps a shade high in the weights now.

runners_data.name: Ruby's Profit
runners_data.note: Confirmed leader but disappointing last effort at Goodwood suggests current form is questionable.

runners_data.name: Marty Hopkirk
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who needs to bounce back from poor recent efforts but has tactical pace for this trip.

runners_data.name: Sturlasson
runners_data.note: Versatile prominent runner whose best form comes with strong pace to aim at but trainer struggling for winners.

races.paceDynamic: Ruby's Profit and Angel Shared will contest the early lead with both confirmed front runners committed to dictating from the gate. This honest gallop will stretch the field over 5f at Bath, creating genuine tempo from start to finish. The prominent runners Fidelius, Regal Envoy, Marty Hopkirk and Sturlasson will track the leaders closely, while hold-up horses Moulin Booj and Desert Cop face a tactical disadvantage. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can sit handy behind the pace-setters and strike when the front duo weaken.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuine between Ruby's Profit and Angel Shared
scenarios.body: The leaders will weaken in the final furlong allowing prominent runners with tactical speed to take over. Fidelius and Regal Envoy are perfectly positioned to exploit this scenario with their proven ability to finish strongly from handy positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of Ruby's Profit or Angel Shared gets first run on their rival
scenarios.body: The winner will have enough left to hold off the late challengers having controlled the tempo. Angel Shared's recent Goodwood form suggests she can sustain her effort better than Ruby's Profit who disappointed last time.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Charge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is very strong and the field comes back to the closers
scenarios.body: Moulin Booj and Desert Cop will have too much ground to make up despite their finishing kicks. The 5f trip at Bath rarely allows for dramatic come-from-behind victories when the pace is honest.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Pace Suits All
scenarios.trigger: If Ruby's Profit and Angel Shared go too fast early and tie up badly
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with moderate pace allowing any running style to win. This would particularly suit horses like Sturlasson who has tactical speed but lacks the finishing kick of the main contenders.

watchPoints.text: Ruby's Profit could set unsustainable fractions if taking on Angel Shared too aggressively early which would compromise both leaders
Fidelius breaking slowly from the stalls would force him further back than ideal against this confirmed pace
Desert Cop being held up too far back early when honest pace likely to stretch the field throughout
Angel Shared and Ruby's Profit both missing the break would create false pace and change the entire complexion
Moulin Booj getting closer to the pace than usual which would suggest connections expect stronger tempo

runners_data.name: Tees Aggregates

races.paceDynamic: Smooth Silesie will take this field along at a comfortable tempo from the front, with Over Spiced likely to race prominently in second. With four hold-up horses (Aces Wild, Toolatetonegotiate, Diomed Spirit, Tees Aggregates) content to settle behind, there's minimal early pressure on the leader. The pace will be honest but not searingly quick, setting up a tactical finish where positioning matters more than pure speed. This measured gallop strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can dictate terms without being harassed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Smooth Leader Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Smooth Silesie gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The front-runner exploits the lack of early pace pressure to control the race completely, building an unassailable advantage. Hold-up horses find too much to do against a horse who has conserved energy by setting his own fractions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Takeover
scenarios.trigger: If Over Spiced tracks the leader perfectly and strikes decisively in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The speedy filly uses her proven 5f handicap winning ability to time her challenge perfectly from her ideal stalking position. Her recent return run sharpness gives her the edge over rustier rivals in a driving finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace collapses completely and becomes crawling
scenarios.body: The moderate early gallop turns into a sprint finish where the best closing kick wins rather than tactical positioning. Aces Wild's recent good form and proven 5f ability could see him time his run to perfection.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Shock
scenarios.trigger: If Smooth Silesie fails to lead or gets headed early by Over Spiced creating chaos
scenarios.body: The anticipated pace scenario falls apart when the expected leader doesn't perform his role, creating a messy tactical affair. This opens the door for an outsider like Diomed Spirit to benefit from the confusion at generous odds.

watchPoints.text: If Smooth Silesie doesn't take up the early running as expected, the entire pace dynamic collapses
Over Spiced's behaviour in the early stages after racing too freely last time will determine her chances
The positioning of the four hold-up horses turning for home - they need to be within striking distance to matter
Harry Davies on Smooth Silesie getting the fractions right - too slow early could backfire, too fast plays into hold-up hands
Any market moves for Diomed Spirit given his outsider status but proven 5f ability at this track

races.paceDynamic: Sands Of Seve is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the rail, likely getting an uncontested lead in this small field. The prominent runners Takincareofbizness, Cougar Force, and Rogue Rebellion will track behind but none are aggressive pace pressers, allowing Sands Of Seve to control the tempo. With six hold-up horses including Baileys Ontherocks, Miss Ayala, Ken Brulee, Cape Toronada, and Magnificent Mel sitting at the back, there's a clear pace divide that will create a sustainable gallop followed by a cavalry charge finish. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up horses who will benefit from the even tempo and get first run on the leaders turning for home.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Sands Of Seve sets a steady pace without pressure from the prominent group
scenarios.body: The backmarkers get the perfect setup with even fractions before unleashing their finishing kicks, while the front group becomes sitting ducks. Baileys Ontherocks and Miss Ayala are perfectly positioned to exploit this tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners applies more pressure than expected, creating a stronger gallop
scenarios.body: Takincareofbizness or Rogue Rebellion capitalize on their forward positions while the hold-up horses find the pace too strong to reel in. The increased tempo plays to horses already handy rather than those needing to make up ground.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Sands Of Seve gets very soft fractions and the hold-up horses leave their runs too late
scenarios.body: The leader maintains enough in reserve to repel late challenges, benefiting from Robert Cowell's training and Harry Davies knowing the tactical situation. The closers get there too late despite the setup.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Upset
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes pedestrian early with no one willing to commit
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint from the 2f pole where any horse can win regardless of running style. An outsider with a turn of foot like Miss Magic Dragon could capitalise on the chaos.

watchPoints.text: Sands Of Seve could get very soft fractions as the sole leader with no pressure from behind, making him dangerous despite his front-running vulnerability
Takincareofbizness showed good recent form with a second place 6 days ago and his prominent style could catch the hold-up horses napping if they wait too long
Miss Magic Dragon's uncertain running style and Pat Cosgrave booking suggests connections expect improvement, making her interesting at a price
The large group of hold-up horses could get in each other's way in the finish if they all come with runs simultaneously
William Carson riding Cape Toronada despite his poor recent form might indicate the horse is better than his ratings suggest

races.paceDynamic: Mrembo and Bobby Dassler are the only prominent/forward runners in this field of 9, which creates a sustainable early tempo without pressure. With 7 hold-up horses sitting behind this modest pace, the race will develop into a patient affair with most runners waiting to make their moves. The lack of genuine speed means the race will be run at a searching gallop over this 1m3½f trip on good to firm ground. This tactical setup strongly favours the hold-up horses who can time their challenges late, as the modest early pace will leave plenty in the tank for the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Patient Hold-Up Victory
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace stays steady with Mrembo and Bobby Dassler not going too hard
scenarios.body: The 7 hold-up horses get the perfect setup to unleash finishing kicks over the final 3 furlongs. Class horses like Beaune and Two Plus Two can showcase their stamina and turn of foot when it matters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Forward Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Mrembo kicks clear turning for home and the hold-up brigade leave it too late
scenarios.body: The 7-year-old gets first run on his rivals and has enough left to hold off the late challengers. Bobby Dassler could also benefit from tracking the leader throughout.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Mess Unfolds
scenarios.trigger: If both prominent runners go too slow and create a sprint finish from the 2-furlong pole
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with positioning crucial as 9 horses converge in a bunched finish. The best-drawn and luckiest in running prevails over pure ability.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If neither Mrembo nor Bobby Dassler show early speed and the field crawls along
scenarios.body: Someone from the hold-up ranks is forced to make the running earlier than ideal, disrupting their preferred tactics. This creates an even more extreme test of stamina.

watchPoints.text: Mrembo could get an uncontested lead with Bobby Dassler's poor recent form, making the favourite very hard to peg back
Two Plus Two faces fitness concerns after 347 days off despite his class advantage over this trip
Virtual Hug's 0-18 turf record on the Flat makes him hard to trust despite his AW and hurdles ability
The 5lb and 3lb claiming jockeys on Mrembo and Bobby Dassler could affect the early pace-setting battle
Beaune's 0-9 turf record conflicts with his strong recent AW form over similar distances

races.paceDynamic: Alice's Influence will lead unopposed with only Shes Got The Blues offering any early pace from a prominent position. The rest are hold-up horses who will be content to sit behind what should be a steady, uncontested tempo through the early stages. With 8 of 10 runners preferring to come from off the pace, Alice's Influence can dictate terms without pressure until the business end. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will plague the majority hold-up brigade in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Scores
scenarios.trigger: If Alice's Influence maintains her recent improvement and gets the expected soft lead
scenarios.body: She can control the race from the front and has already shown winning form over this trip on good going. The hold-up horses will struggle to organize behind her with so many needing room at once.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow early and Alice's Influence stops in front
scenarios.body: The better hold-up horses with tactical speed will sweep past a weakening leader. Lady Of Clover and Mali Star have both shown improved form recently and can benefit from the expected strong pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Shes Got The Blues can sit close enough to Alice's Influence without overracing
scenarios.body: She gets first run on the leader while avoiding the traffic that will engulf the rear division. Her recent form shows consistent placed efforts and the step up in trip should suit.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: One of the bigger-priced hold-up horses like Marveling or Henfield could benefit from a true-run race at longer odds. The handicapper may have been lenient with the improving types.
